metadata.report_title: MediScanAI Consolidated RAGAS Optimization Master Report
metadata.scope: Comprehensive forensic history across candidates A2, A3, A4, A5, A6, A6.1, A7, A8, heldout validation, baseline R0, and retrieval benchmarks.

datasets.description: Full end-to-end clinical evaluation dataset with multimodal OCR labels, reference context IDs, and golden clinical summaries.
Frozen stratified development subset (seed 42) used for all A2–A8 and A6.1 iterative engineering evaluations.
Frozen stratified held-out validation subset (seed 42) with strictly 0 overlap with dev subset, containing 5 emergency cases.

R0_offline.name: R0 (Full Offline Baseline)
R0_offline.notes: Full 110-case run. 86 NaNs due to evaluator timeouts on unconstrained prompts.

R0s.name: R0s (Dev Subset Pre-Hygiene)
R0s.notes: Pilot scoring run on frozen dev subset before compact evidence.

A1.name: Candidate A1 (Compact Evidence)
A1.notes: Replaced raw dictionary string dumps with compact evidence and token budget.

A2.name: Candidate A2 (Prompt v2 Baseline)
A2.notes: Introduced role separation, evidence neutralization, citation tracking [E1]-[E5].

A3.name: Candidate A3 (Intent Routing v2)
A3.notes: Deterministic intent classifier; skipped disease retrieval on medicine-directed queries.

A4.name: Candidate A4 (Prompt v3)
A4.notes: Added conditional indications verdict and grounded unanswerable handling.

A5.name: Candidate A5 (Prompt v4 & Multi-Ingredient)
A5.notes: Multi-ingredient formulation parsing, brand filtering, Prompt v4.

A6.name: Candidate A6 (Prompt v5 Best Final)
A6.notes: Claim-level grounding, positive indication framing, deterministic claim sanitization.

A6.1.name: Candidate A6.1 (Triage Fix Candidate)
A6.1.notes: Targeted disclaimer removal & container normalizer. Net mean reduced by judge few-shot leakage on E2E-080.

A7.name: Candidate A7 (Evidence Sufficiency Regression)
A7.notes: Evidence sufficiency states & negative abstention prompts. Regressed due to Meta-Absence Judge Penalty.

A8.name: Candidate A8 (Strict Entity Isolation)
A8.notes: Unified prompt v7, strict product isolation, and positive indication grounding.

heldout_A2.name: Held-Out A2 (Baseline)
heldout_A2.notes: Independent baseline on 30 held-out cases with 0 dev overlap.

heldout_A6.name: Held-Out A6 (Best Final)
heldout_A6.notes: Final best candidate on 30 held-out cases. Reached 0.7064 mean and 0.9075 emergency.

optimization_ledger.target: Raw dictionary dumps blowing context limit (8,656 tokens P95)
optimization_ledger.hypothesis: Structured compact text format with token budget manager will prevent context truncation and lower hallucination.
optimization_ledger.dev_outcome: Faithfulness improved from 0.3553 (R0s) to 0.6001 (A1). Truncation dropped from 12.7% to 0%.
optimization_ledger.heldout_outcome: Confirmed foundational prerequisite across all runs.

optimization_ledger.target: Unconstrained generation template and few-shot vitamin leakage
optimization_ledger.hypothesis: Role separation, explicit evidence neutralization, and structured verdict headers will enforce clinical discipline.
optimization_ledger.dev_outcome: A2 scored 0.5282. Role separation worked, but without intent routing, irrelevant disease chunks polluted medicine queries.
optimization_ledger.regressions: Introduced citation tracking [E1]-[E5] which judge initially struggled with before normalization.

optimization_ledger.target: Irrelevant disease evidence retrieved on pure medicine scans
optimization_ledger.hypothesis: Deterministic intent classifier to skip disease retrieval for medicine-directed queries will eliminate cross-domain noise.
optimization_ledger.dev_outcome: A3 faithfulness jumped to 0.6558 (+0.1276 over A2). Medicine clean OCR jumped from 0.5667 to 0.8929.
optimization_ledger.heldout_outcome: Essential architectural pillar across A4, A5, A6.

optimization_ledger.target: Forced negative mismatch verdicts on match cases and ungrounded unanswerables
optimization_ledger.hypothesis: Conditional indications verdict and explicit abstention instructions will eliminate false negative bias.
optimization_ledger.dev_outcome: A4 jumped to 0.7256 (+0.0698 over A3). Symptom+med match jumped from 0.4948 to 0.7688.
optimization_ledger.regressions: Unanswerable cases still had residual probe token leakage.

optimization_ledger.target: Active ingredient attribution failure on multi-substance labels
optimization_ledger.hypothesis: Multi-ingredient formulation parsing, brand filtering, and Prompt v4 will isolate compound components.
optimization_ledger.dev_outcome: A5 jumped to 0.7538 (+0.0282 over A4). Noisy medicine OCR jumped from 0.8000 to 0.9333.
optimization_ledger.regressions: Attributed overall product indications to constituent single ingredients in combination kits.

optimization_ledger.target: Negative symptom exclusions ('not indicated for') and conversational additive claims
optimization_ledger.hypothesis: Positive indication framing and deterministic claim sanitization will eliminate ungrounded negative claims.
optimization_ledger.dev_outcome: A6 achieved 0.8021 Mean, 1.0000 Median (Program Peak). Medicine clean OCR reached 1.0000.
optimization_ledger.heldout_outcome: A6 won heldout evaluation at 0.7064 Mean, 0.9075 Emergency.
optimization_ledger.regressions: Residual negative disclaimers under Alternatives in symptom-only queries.

optimization_ledger.target: Explicitly declaring what the evidence lacks via EvidenceSufficiencyState
optimization_ledger.hypothesis: Instructing model to declare 'Labeled indications are not stated in the available sources' will demonstrate rigorous abstention.
optimization_ledger.dev_outcome: Severe regression: A7 collapsed to 0.6088 (70 unsupported statements).
optimization_ledger.regressions: Triggered the Meta-Absence Judge Penalty: RAGAS judge penalizes claims stating context lacks information.

optimization_ledger.target: Cross-entity attribute bleeding without negative meta-abstention
optimization_ledger.hypothesis: Strict product isolation and positive indication grounding will recover from A7 regression.
optimization_ledger.dev_outcome: A8 recovered to 0.7096, but remained inferior to A6 (0.8021).
optimization_ledger.regressions: Entity isolation instructions added prompt length without exceeding A6's natural precision.

optimization_ledger.target: Symptom-only negative disclaimers and combination product container attribution
optimization_ledger.hypothesis: Deterministic negative-disclaimer stripping and physical container attribution normalizer will fix residual triage failures.
optimization_ledger.dev_outcome: Triage fixes fully verified on E2E-073 (1.0) and E2E-024 (1.0). Net mean dropped to 0.7614 due to judge few-shot leakage on E2E-080.
optimization_ledger.regressions: Exposed judge vulnerability to Ragas prompt leakage.
optimization_ledger.decision: HOLD IN DEV BRANCH (HARDEN JUDGE BEFORE PROMOTION)

RC1_RETRIEVAL.name: Retrieval Failures
RC1_RETRIEVAL.description: Mismatch between query entity and retrieved document, insufficient coverage, or non-overlapping disease symptom lists.
RC1_RETRIEVAL.mitigation: Routing v2 intent classifier, drug dictionary fallback for degraded OCR.

RC2_EVIDENCE_ASSEMBLY.name: Evidence Construction and Selection
RC2_EVIDENCE_ASSEMBLY.description: Product-level indications attributed to individual active ingredients in multi-component kits or combination drugs.
RC2_EVIDENCE_ASSEMBLY.mitigation: Attribution normalizer binding indications to product entities rather than isolated chemical salts.

RC3_CANDIDATE_GENERATION.name: Candidate Generation & Hallucination
RC3_CANDIDATE_GENERATION.description: Unsupported negative claims under Suggested Alternatives, or unneeded elaboration beyond retrieved clinical label text.
RC3_CANDIDATE_GENERATION.mitigation: Deterministic sanitizer replacing negative disclaimers with 'Not applicable: no medicine provided.'.

RC4_PROMPTING_ROUTING.name: Prompting and Routing
RC4_PROMPTING_ROUTING.description: Prompts forcing the model to explain nonexistent mismatches or assert meta-absence of information.
RC4_PROMPTING_ROUTING.mitigation: Prompt v5 positive indication framing; complete elimination of negative meta-absence prompts.

RC5_SANITIZATION.name: Sanitization and Post-Processing
RC5_SANITIZATION.description: Citation tag syntax errors and ungrounded disclaimer leakage.
RC5_SANITIZATION.mitigation: Deterministic regex claim validator normalizing [E1]-[E10] and stripping invalid tags.

RC6_EVALUATOR_INTEGRITY.name: Evaluation / Judge Failures
RC6_EVALUATOR_INTEGRITY.description: Few-shot prompt example leakage (Albert Einstein statements), JSON parser crashes (E2E-062), and Meta-Absence Judge Penalties.
RC6_EVALUATOR_INTEGRITY.mitigation: Requires judge prompt hardening (stripping few-shot examples or enforcing Pydantic grammar schemas).

RC7_DATASET_LIMITATIONS.name: Dataset & Reference Limitations
RC7_DATASET_LIMITATIONS.description: Unanswerable fictitious probes containing synthetic strings not present in FDA labels, causing unavoidable judge penalties.
RC7_DATASET_LIMITATIONS.mitigation: Entity-neutral abstention phrasing ('The requested clinical information could not be verified').

unresolved_issues.title: Evaluator Few-Shot Contamination (Albert Einstein Leakage)
unresolved_issues.impact: Severe (0.00 score on E2E-080, reducing A6.1 mean by 0.025 across 40 dev cases)
unresolved_issues.mechanism: Local llama3.1:8b judge emits few-shot example claims from internal Ragas prompt when parsing fails.
unresolved_issues.recommendation: Harden Ragas statement generator prompt; remove persona few-shot examples or enforce grammar schema.

unresolved_issues.title: Ragas JSON Output Parser Exception on E2E-062
unresolved_issues.impact: Score invalidation (NaN on A6.1 and A8)
unresolved_issues.mechanism: Ollama emitted trailing markdown backticks or invalid JSON escaping, causing RagasOutputParserException.
unresolved_issues.recommendation: Add robust JSON cleaner wrapper before delegating to Ragas LangChain parser.

unresolved_issues.title: Fictitious Drug Probe Penalization in Unanswerable Category
unresolved_issues.impact: Category score ceiling (~0.40 on dev and held-out)
unresolved_issues.mechanism: Judge extracts probe drug name (e.g. Glycozempra), checks context, finds 0 mentions, and marks claim unfaithful.
unresolved_issues.recommendation: Implement entity-neutral abstention rules that avoid echoing fictitious drug names in the output.

unresolved_issues.title: Development to Held-Out Generalization Gap
unresolved_issues.impact: A6 achieved 0.8021 on dev but 0.7064 on held-out (-0.0957 gap)
unresolved_issues.mechanism: Held-out set introduces emergency cases (5 cases) and novel combination products (BP Reg, Virus Defense).
unresolved_issues.recommendation: Expand stratified evaluation to full 110-case benchmark once judge hardening is complete.
